text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Congrats, Fula-ran!
That was so intense!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes...!
Thank you very much...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hm, you doing okay?
Want me to pat your back?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
*Inhale*... *phew*...
...Yes, I'm okay now!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Oh, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Aww, she totally beat me to the kiss~!
Guess the win flag was actually a defeat flag!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe I should plant a kiss too!?
Like, a 'Congrats & HBD' vibe! What d'ya think!?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Chu~☆

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Helios. A wind is blowing from Ms. Nature's direction
to lift your spirits.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Fo' real!? You're riding such a good vibe!?
Nature~! Gotta post this on Umastagram!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Flower-san.
Congratulations."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Th-Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest... the reason
I gave up 'this spot' to you was...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It feels as though the wind has vanished from my body.
It's truly frustrating...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
To tell the truth, I couldn't afford to yield.
Not if I wanted to reach what lies 'beyond'...",
  {"id": 42, "en": "The truth is, I was thinking about giving up on running...
Because I'm not suited for it at all...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...The next time I face Flower-san
will be at the Takamatsunomiya Kinen, won't it?"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Congratulations once again. However, next time,
I shall return as a fierce gale."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I've become the champion...♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes!
choice_data_list: Tonight, let's eat whatever you like!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wah, that sounds great...!
Let's celebrate♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
What would you like to eat?
Please, order anything you want!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Huh.
Um...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Huh.
I can't think of anything.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It seems that... I really like
"making things"...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'd still love to hear lots of your requests, Trainer♪
